name: Chatty: almost every face comes with words, and every prompt gets one
case: The person has set Boop to Chatty. They ask an agent for something new, plainly, and Boop answers with a face and words, holding up a sign. The short turn finishes well and Boop cheers it with words. Twenty seconds later they ask the agent, plainly again, to run the tests: even though Boop only just reacted, it gets a face and a word. That turn finishes too, and Boop says something about it.
why: talk/chatty.md: almost every face comes with words, a word or a phrase sooner than a sound; every prompt gets a face and a word however recently Boop reacted, and a sign when there's one to hold up
